notes.title: Serbian Games Week: Discounts, New Bundle and Our Next Game!
notes.notes:
We’re part of Serbian Games Week! Discover awesome games at a discount all week long.
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/SerbianGamesWeek2025
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/SerbianGamesWeek2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/0630317b984b6d579c175b20629a1fc09b898313.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Serbian Games Week[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/SerbianGamesWeek2025]Serbian Games Week[/url] - over 120 titles on the Steam sale event featuring Serbian games

From Monday, September 22, gamers around the world will have the opportunity to browse, buy, or wishlist games made in Serbia. Some of over 120 games will be heavily discounted, while others will soon be published.

[url=https://sga.rs/?snr=1_614_615_serbiangamesweek2025_1601]The Serbian Games Association[/url] (SGA) has curated and launched Serbian Games Week, seven days of promotion and celebration of the success of the Serbian gaming ecosystem on Steam. 

There are more than 120 games on the list. It includes a wide variety of titles: from action, strategy and adventure, AA and indie projects, to games inspired by Slavic mythology. The search for the perfect game is made easier through categories and filters by genre.

Five games were singled out in the Epic Experiences category. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753900/The_King_is_Watching/]The King is Watching[/url], a new title from the publisher tinyBuild, is a roguelite kingdom-building game in which the player rules with the power of their gaze. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029780/Going_Medieval/]Going Medieval[/url], by the indie team Foxy Voxel, is a cozy city builder simulator with, as the word itself suggests, a medieval theme. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/588030/Derail_Valley/]DerailValley[/url] is the title of the studio Altfuture, a train driving simulator through beautiful, but also challenging landscapes. Entertainment Forge is behind [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043260/Gladiator_Guild_Manager/]Gladiator Guild Manager[/url], a strategic autobattle simulation of gladiators fighting. Fifth in this section is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1525700/Tavern_Master/]Tavern Master[/url] by Untitled Studio, another simulation set in the Middle Ages, but in this one, you build your perfect inn.

Serbian Games Week will last from September 22nd to 29th.


[h1]Our Next Game[/h1]
Don’t forget to wishlist and follow our newest title, Dreadwoods Gatekeeper! A complete visual overhaul and demo are coming soon.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Our New Game – A Story-Driven Medieval Fantasy Gatekeeping Sim
notes.notes:
Hello!

I wanted to share the latest game I’ve been working on. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/]Dreadwoods Gatekeeper[/url] is a story-driven medieval fantasy gatekeeping simulation.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/

Much like Scheming Through, this game is heavily story-driven. It will focus on a gatekeeping job simulator, a mystery-thriller story with many characters and layers, and a touch of bow combat that you’ll master alongside the protagonist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398339/67434b4257309e761c7a00ad60ca3b256cbc47d8.gif[/img]

You arrive in the small town of Dreadwoods to take on the job of gatekeeper. The previous guard was killed, the townsfolk cling to strange superstitions, barricading their homes at the sound of the Minster bell, and new rumors of a monster lurking in the woods are spreading.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33677394/6e1c8a733a262b47eba304815a08a08a5bfa6a0f.gif[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/]Wishlist and follow the game[/url], or join my [url=https://discord.gg/RjXjQveAwZ]Discord Community[/url] to be among the first to try an early demo I’m working on. I’d also love your feedback and help in shaping this game into something we’ll all enjoy.

[url=https://discord.gg/RjXjQveAwZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398339/4c4cc6304d503a033e1217ce8e4094be1c96eb7e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Episode 2 Release Date Announced: New Silly Adventures Await Hank and Larry!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398339/0a4a570ea9ac1e7c7f4cbfbd9530be9b0fda2dad.png[/img]
Hello! We know it’s been forever, but Episode 2 is finally ready, and we have the release date. I don’t want to go into too much detail about the delay and point fingers. But we really are sorry for not being able to release it a lot earlier. Still, we really love how Episode 2 turned out, and we are super excited to finally release it.

We are planning on releasing the game on 23rd April 2024.


Episode two continues the story of Hank and Larry and their struggle through the zombie apocalypse while obviously not having what it takes to make it. So, they keep using their wits to collaborate with other animals and get them to do the hard work of scavenging.

Spoiler ahead if you haven’t played episode 1. [spoiler] They reached the scavengers guild at the end of Episode 1, but in order to stay there, they need to keep bringing in the loot. Stakes are even higher as they found out that animals who bring the most loot will get a ticket to zombie-free island. But competing with other animals like huge bull brothers seems impossible, and our guys will need to up their game if they want to stand a chance at winning. [/spoiler]

[previewyoutube=lebf1WlBCic;full][/previewyoutube]

Again, we hope you can forgive us for this ridiculously and stupidly long delay.
I'd love to have you in our small [url=https://discord.gg/jyUzQkZ ]Discord Community[/url] where we can talk about Episode 2 as it comes out, or anything else.
Thank you! 
-Entertainment Forge Team

notes.title: Two More Days Until Full Voice Acting Update!
notes.notes:
Alright, this took 3 months instead of 3 weeks as we planned. But we collaborated with some amazing voice actors and are more than happy with how the game turned out.

So finally, this Friday you'll be able to play the game with full voice acting!
